rationale: The agent did not follow policy or the user’s stated intent. Issues: (1) No explicit user confirmation before executing order-changing writes; multiple return_delivered_order_items calls were made without confirming item(s) or refund method. (2) The user wanted to return only the more expensive tablet with refund to credit card; only if that was impossible should everything on that order be returned to a gift card. Instead, the agent processed returns for two different items across two orders and split refunds—one to credit card and one to gift card—without justification. (3) Duplicate return attempts for the same item to a gift card suggest erroneous or unsupported actions. (4) Final message states both tablets are being returned, contradicting the user’s request, and claims outcomes not clearly supported by tool results. While the agent did look up the user via name/zip and retrieved order details, the critical failures—unconfirmed writes, incorrect execution relative to user intent, and inconsistent final info—mean the task was not completed in line with policy.
